info.description: Query the number lookup details of any E.164 number. It provides the type of subscriber, current and parent network and MCCMNC if type Mobile. It returns the type of connection i.e fixed or mobile which allows the customer to send traffic to mobile sub.
info.title: Number Intelligence API

get.description: get the routing details of a given number

parameters.name: phnum
parameters.description: subscriber number either fixed or mobile

spn.description: Service Provider Network Represents the identity of the port-corrected operator serving the TN

altSpn.description: Alternative SPN Represents the identity of the port-corrected operator serving the TN when the SPN alone is insufficient

mcc.description: Mobile Country Code; a three-digit code assigned to a country that is the first part of the identity as defined in ITU E.212 Recommendation

mnc.description: Mobile Network Code; a two or three-digit code under an MCC assigned to a Mobile Operator that is the second part of the identity as defined in ITU E.212 Recommendation.

403.description: Customer has been authenticated but customer isn't having access on the requested data

404.description: No data present for the queried TN

get.summary: number lookup records of the user
get.description: get the number lookup history transactions of the user going back to last 180 days maximum

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: total records in a page. By default, page size would be 100. Maximum allowed size is 100

totalRecords.description: total number of records of the user

timestamp.description: timestamp of the transaction. for eg. 10 Jan 2021 12:12:09
